Me ne consolo · v'esibisco la mia protezione
Leporello! · Presto va con costor · Ho capito; andiam

licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker (clean). Secco recitative, printed without a key signature. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out; where the print gives a second rhythm for the English words (bars 45, 46, 49), the Italian rhythm is kept. In bar 14 the top note of the left hand's first chord is printed E without a flat (perhaps a misprint for E flat) and is kept as printed. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 94, from the median length (2:16) of five complete recordings, which give this recitative a track of its own (Fricsay 1958 2:11, Giulini 1959 2:00, Böhm 1977 2:16, Haitink 1984 2:20, Karajan 1985 2:20). Schirmer prints Recit. only.
